§6Ore Acidizer§f

§aThe only machine that makes cadmium, arsenic, and crystalline fullerite - plus ore multiplication!§f

The §bOre Acidizer§f (also called the crystallizer) processes items using various solvents. It requires §bDesh§f to craft, gating it at post-oil. It is essential for ore multiplication, crystalline fullerite, and obtaining resources that cannot be found anywhere else.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Factory):
§b•§f §e2×§f Welded Steel Plate, §e3×§f Titanium Shell, §e4×§f Desh Ingot, §e1×§f Motor, §e2×§f Integrated Circuit Board.

§6Operation§f:
§b•§f Consumes §e1 kHE/t§f base, recipes take §e1–30 seconds§f (20 to 600 kHE total).
§b•§f §e8,000 mB§f fluid tank, §e1 MHE§f energy buffer, 8 ports.
§b•§f 2 upgrade slots: Speed, Effectiveness, and Overdrive (up to level 3).

§6Exclusive Outputs§f:
§b•§f Cadmium, Crystalline Fullerite, and Arsenic - only from the Acidizer.
§b•§f 23 crystallizing recipes for ore multiplication.
§b•§f Chemical Dyes from Wood Oil + powders.

§ePS:§f The §eEffectiveness Upgrade§f gives a chance to not consume inputs - great for expensive recipes. The §eOverdrive Upgrade§f divides duration with no downside, strictly better than Speed!
